issues.description: The problem statement explicitly instructs to output exactly the requested columns (Zoo name and url, and Gemeinde name and regierungsbezirk). The solution file for Aufgabe 01 uses SELECT Zoo.*, Gemeinde.* which returns all columns from both tables (more than requested). This contradicts the problem instruction and can confuse students or cause mismatches with automated checks expecting only the specified columns.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution (and/or template example) for Aufgabe 01 to select exactly the required columns. For example: SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk FROM Zoo JOIN Gemeinde ON Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel; This keeps the solution consistent with the problem instruction to output only the requested data.
